purpose: Destructive blind test for the promoted metadata candidate that 741-060 feeds a terminal 060-920 cap.

design.neutralization: Printed object labels are cropped out where visible; panels expose only neutral IDs BT001..BT012.

promotion_rule: The candidate strengthens if blind readers recover either the full 741-060-920 terminal cluster in the positive set, or the broader 060-920 cap including the non-741 diagnostic row, without object IDs or catalog strings.
failure_rule: If readers cannot separate 060-920-bearing rows from controls, or if controls without 060-920 are read as the same terminal cluster at comparable rates, the terminal-cap candidate remains metadata-only and does not move toward acceptance.
